from collections import Counter
import math
def f_rowcol(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0]); bgc=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ms=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if inp[i][j]!=bgc]; mset=set(ms)
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    for aa in sorted(ms):
        for bb in sorted(ms):
            if aa>=bb: continue
            if bb[0]==aa[0]:   # same row
                rng=range(min(bb[1],aa[1]),max(bb[1],aa[1])+1)
                for j in rng:
                    if (aa[0],j) not in mset: out[aa[0]][j]=3
            elif bb[1]==aa[1]: # same col
                rng=range(min(aa[0],bb[0]),max(aa[0],bb[0])+1)
                for k in rng:
                    if (k,aa[1]) not in mset: out[k][aa[1]]=3
            else: continue
    return out
for p in range(1,8):
    pred=f_rowcol(G[f'Demo pair {p} input']); e=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    print(p,sum(1 for i in range(len(pred)) for j in range(len(pred[0])) if pred[i][j]!=e[i][j]))
